governance_note: All state transitions require logged events. No automated approval transitions — human_in_the_loop required at every gate.

run_states.description: Lifecycle of a Mass Valuation Run from creation to archive.

draft.label: مسودة
draft.description: Run created; parameters configured; no training initiated.

training.label: قيد التدريب
training.description: Model training in progress; data locked for reproducibility.

validated.label: مُتحقَّق منه
validated.description: Automated validation passed (schema, IAAO metrics computed, OOD identified). Awaiting human review.

approved_for_internal_use.label: معتمد للاستخدام الداخلي
approved_for_internal_use.description: Human reviewer approved for internal advisory use only. Not for external disclosure.

active.label: نشط
active.description: Run is the current production run for internal advisory outputs.
active.notes: Only one run per property_type × jurisdiction can be 'active' simultaneously.

challenger.label: مُقارِن
challenger.description: A newer run being tested in parallel with the active run. Used for A/B comparison.

deprecated.label: مُهمَل
deprecated.description: Run superseded by a newer active run. Outputs preserved for audit trail.

rejected.label: مرفوض
rejected.description: Run failed validation or human review. Cannot be reactivated.

archived.label: مُؤرشَف
archived.description: Run and all its outputs archived. Read-only. Required retention period: 7 years (Saudi regulations).

property_states.description: Status of an individual property prediction within a mass valuation run.

in_distribution.label: ضمن نطاق النموذج
in_distribution.description: Property falls within the training distribution; model prediction is applicable.

out_of_distribution.label: خارج نطاق النموذج
out_of_distribution.description: Property characteristics fall outside the training distribution (OOD). Prediction retained with OOD flag and increased uncertainty.
out_of_distribution.output_label: تنبيه: خارج نطاق النموذج — مراجعة مطلوبة
out_of_distribution.notes: Prediction interval widens automatically. Human review required before any advisory use.

insufficient_evidence.label: أدلة غير كافية
insufficient_evidence.description: Missing required input fields (price, location, area) prevent reliable prediction. No value assigned.
insufficient_evidence.notes: GOVERNANCE: No imputed value is assigned. Record documented as insufficient_evidence.

manual_review_required.label: يتطلّب مراجعة يدوية
manual_review_required.description: Quality flags (anomaly, near-duplicate, currency ambiguity, OOD, missing location) triggered. Human reviewer must inspect before output is released.
manual_review_required.notes: Prediction may be computed but is withheld until human review complete.

reviewed.label: مُراجَع
reviewed.description: Human reviewer has inspected the prediction and either accepted the model value or assigned an override value.
reviewed.notes: Review decision captured in ReviewDecision data model.

approved_for_release.label: معتمد للإصدار
approved_for_release.description: Prediction reviewed and approved for inclusion in the advisory output. Final state before reporting.
approved_for_release.notes: Approval logged with reviewer ID and timestamp.

rejected.label: مرفوض
rejected.description: Prediction rejected by human reviewer. Reason documented. Excluded from all outputs.
rejected.notes: Rejection reason required. Record retained in audit trail.

actor.description: User ID or 'system' for automated transitions
